name: InteractionContainer
description:
Access to interactions<Interaction> of simulation, by using 

#. id's of both Bodies<Body> of the interactions, e.g. ``O.interactions[23,65]``
#. iteraction over the whole container::

	for i in O.interactions: print i.id1,i.id2

.. note::
	Iteration silently skips interactions that are virtual...

methods.name: has
methods.description: Tell if a pair of ids *id1*, *id2* corresponds to an existing interaction (real<Interaction.isReal> or not depending on *onlyReal*)

methods.name: countReal
methods.description: Return number of interactions that are real<Interaction.isReal>.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Return n-th interaction from the container (usable for picking random interaction). The virtual interactions are not reached.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Return list of real<Interaction.isReal> interactions of given body.

methods.name: withBodyAll
methods.description: Return list of all (real<Interaction.isReal> as well as non-real) interactions of given body.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Return list of all interactions. Virtual interaction are filtered out if onlyReal=True, else (default) it dumps the full content.

methods.name: eraseNonReal
methods.description: Erase all interactions that are not real <Interaction.isReal>.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Erase one interaction, given by id1, id2 (internally, requestErase is called -- the interaction might still exist as potential, if the Collider decides so).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all interactions, and invalidate persistent collider data (if the collider supports it).
